extra.reason: Merged: https://github.com/Mesh-America/supply-drop-bbs/pull/248

Root cause found and fixed: /opt/supply-drop-bbs was never touched by the .deb-based upgrade (tracked separately as supply-drop-bbs-536), and once manually synced, the sync itself hit the fetch bug fixed in supply-drop-bbs-e5n / #247-248. Confirmed resolved on production (mesh-america-bbs): BBS now independently verified as Room Server via MeshCore contact details and the corescope map.
Merged: https://github.com/Mesh-America/supply-drop-bbs/pull/269

Docs-only fix: warning added to docs/OPERATIONS.md and generated pymc-companion.yaml, referencing known upstream openhop_core bug. Cannot fix upstream library from this repo; needs hardware to verify reachability, per issue's own suggested next steps.
Docs-only fix: corrected pymc-companion.yaml.example's sync_word comment to note it is currently dead code upstream (openhop_core reads it but never writes it to the radio).

Fixed: radio.begin() now wraps in try/except so RuntimeError-raising init failures get the same friendly error message as the is-False case; autoadd_config comment corrected in both pymc-companion.py and pymc-companion.yaml.example.

Fixed: docs/OPERATIONS.md's .deb-install Pi HAT callout now accurately states install.sh's guided setup is the only way to set up a Pi HAT bridge for the first time, and fixed a broken anchor link plus a stale claim about .deb updates never touching pymc-companion (no longer true since #243's self-update mechanism).

Fixed: added guestRoomNameMissing validation in SettingsPage.vue, disables Save and shows an inline error instead of silently sending guest_room:null. Also fixed a hostile-audit-found edge case (empty-string guest_room from server incorrectly treated as enabled-with-name) and consistency issues (stale success banner, inconsistent messaging, field-error class convention).

Fixed: traced the real root cause (bbs-mesh's sync_radio_params_if_configured applies [plugins.mesh.radio] on every connect regardless of connection type, but setup.rs's wizard only ever prompted for/wrote it under serial, based on a stale comment). Widened both gates to all connection types, added 4 unit tests, added HAT-specific wizard clarification about the relationship between the two region prompts (per hostile audit finding).

Fixed: Host::advert_location_state() added as an atomic combined snapshot of node_location()+share_location_in_advert(), backed by one RwLock in BbsHost (was two independently-locked fields). Both mesh advert-send paths (broadcast_self_advert, on-connect SelfInfo) and bbs-meshtastic's fixed-position sync now snapshot once instead of racing. Hostile-audited (Extractor+Concurrency, Hostile QA+Verifier); regression test verified to actually catch the reintroduced race. Residual writer-side gap tracked separately (supply-drop-bbs-2nt / #274).

Merged in PR #279 (fix/config-toml-file-locking): added bbs_core::config_lock cross-process advisory lock, extended coverage to 4 additional call sites a hostile audit found, fixed a data-loss bug and a symlink exposure.

Merged in PR #282 (fix/revert-room-server-advert-type): reverted adv_type default from Room(3) back to Chat(1) in all 3 locations, root cause confirmed against upstream MeshCore Companion Radio Protocol docs.

Merged in PR #285: builds the web frontend on the runner before the cross build steps, teaches build.rs to skip npm via BBS_WEB_SKIP_NPM_BUILD, passed through Cross.toml. Verified locally on both paths.
Merged in PR #289: migrates existing adv_type: 3 to 1 in pymc-companion.yaml, both via postinst's unattended .deb-upgrade self-update and via re-running the setup wizard.

Merged in PR #294: strips Unicode display-spoofing codepoints from mesh node names at truncate_mesh_node_name (outbound advert + welcome banner) and to_advert_response (inbound remote-node names in the web admin's Adverts/Contacts panels).
Merged in PR #295: adds user ban/unban CLI commands (the one surface of #252's 3 that was actually missing).
Merged in PR #296.

Documented as accepted risk with a compensating control: a loud warning on unexpected non-fast-forward history (what a rewritten-history attack or force-push would look like). Full signed-tag verification would need release-signing infra this project doesn't have yet.
Fixed: local commits diverging from the fetched branch are now backed up to a timestamped branch before checkout -B, with a warning. Verified via executed repro.

Fixed: a repo-health probe (HEAD resolves) replaces the bare directory-existence check; an unhealthy .git triggers a clean re-clone instead of a permanent failure loop. Verified via executed repro (old logic aborts the whole script under set -e; new logic recovers).
Fixed: a non-empty non-git SRC_DIR is detected before attempting git clone and dies with an actionable message. Verified via executed repro.
Fixed: a failed self-heal fetch now warns and continues with the existing local source instead of aborting the whole script. Verified via executed repro.
Fixed: --uninstall is detected anywhere in the argument list, not just $1.

Documented in CONTRIBUTING.md's new CI & release workflow conventions section: release.yml's cross-migration (#254) already decoupled the glibc floor from the runner OS, so ubuntu-latest is correct there by design; the section now spells that out for any future release-shipping workflow.
Added a short comment at both dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master call sites (release.yml, ci.yml) explaining it's the action's own documented pattern, not an oversight.

Documented the project's deliberate tag-pinning-not-SHA-pinning stance for third-party GitHub Actions in CONTRIBUTING.md, given no dependabot.yml github-actions entry exists yet to keep SHA pins current.
Cross-referenced release.yml's existing inline accepted-risk documentation for cross-rs's tag-pinned Docker images from the new CONTRIBUTING.md section.
Fixed: openhop-core is now pinned to an exact version (1.1.3) in both install.sh and packaging/postinst's unattended self-update path, bumped deliberately in both places together.

Fixed: the no-SelfInfo branch in crates/bbs-mesh/src/transport.rs now logs at warn! with a message spelling out which config-sync steps are skipped. Committed 9fc2b7c on fix/mesh-selfinfo-warn-log. Does not resolve GitHub #225 itself (left open, commented) -- that needs physical/console access to the specific reporting Pi.

Fixed: added bbs_core::toml_util::ensure_table/ensure_subtable, which create an absent section/key as an empty table (same as before) but return Err instead of panicking when it exists with the wrong type. Replaced every unguarded doc[section][key]=value / .as_table_mut().unwrap() call site across api_patch_config, api_patch_radio_config, api_update_native_plugin, save_meshtastic_radio_to_config, save_meshtastic_owner_to_config, doc_set_radio_field, doc_set_mesh_field (bbs-web), and write_plugins, save_radio_config, save_path_bytes, and all 6 config_edit_*/config_remove_* CLI wrappers (main.rs). Regression test: api_patch_config_against_non_table_section_returns_400_not_panic (a real bbs=1 malformed config.toml through the actual HTTP handler, asserts 400 not a panic/500).

Fixed: consolidated the 4 duplicate atomic_write_file copies (main.rs, setup.rs, bbs-web, bbs-core::config_lock's own pre-existing unprotected copy) into one shared, now-public bbs_core::config_lock::atomic_write_file, whose .tmp sibling is opened with O_NOFOLLOW (same pattern as the lock sidecar from #227). Regression test: atomic_write_refuses_to_follow_a_preexisting_tmp_symlink.

Fixed (chose the stronger of the two acceptance-criteria options): moved api_patch_config's post-write side effects (log_reload, Host::set_advert_location_state) to run INSIDE the same locked critical section as the file write, right after atomic_write_file succeeds, instead of after the lock is released. Both are synchronous (no .await), so this doesn't add blocking beyond what the write already does. PatchConfigOutcome struct removed as no longer needed -- the closure now returns io::Result<()>.

Fixed: extracted resolve_greeting_name (crates/bbs-mesh/src/transport.rs), sanitizing the connect-time greeting's {name} source via bbs_core::mesh_name::strip_display_spoofing_codepoints regardless of whether it came from an auto-login username or the remote node's own advert_bus-reported display name. advert_bus itself can't sanitize on ingestion (bbs-plugin-api has no bbs-core dependency, same constraint #228 hit), so this sanitizes at the display site, matching bbs-web's to_advert_response approach. 5 new unit tests on the extracted pure function (transport.rs had zero prior test coverage; extracting this as a pure function made it testable without building full async event-loop test scaffolding).

Partially fixed, rest deliberately deferred as documented accepted risk (lower severity -- sysop-authenticated, self-only surface, per the issue's own framing). Fixed: (1) both startup log lines in main.rs now route cfg.bbs.name through strip_display_spoofing_codepoints before logging. (2) GET /config's response gained bbs_name_has_hidden_codepoints: a computed flag (stored name vs. what truncate_mesh_node_name would actually broadcast), wired into SettingsPage.vue as a warning banner next to the name field (cleared on edit, since we can't know if a retyped value has hidden codepoints without a round trip). Deferred: SettingsPage.vue's client-side validation still only checks C0/C1 control characters, not the full Unicode Format-category range -- would require duplicating bbs_core::mesh_name's codepoint classification logic in TypeScript, and the server-side validate_mesh_node_name/GET-config-flag pairing already catches this before anything is actually broadcast, so the risk is limited to a sysop momentarily seeing an un-flagged spoofed name in the input box between typing and saving.

Duplicate of supply-drop-bbs-9ey (same gh-274 external_ref) -- already fixed via PR #296 (Host::set_advert_location_state, single write-lock acquisition for both fields), which closed 9ey. This bd issue was a leftover duplicate that never got linked/closed at the same time.

This bd issue's own acceptance criteria ('a clear log/UI signal so this class of failure is diagnosable without code archaeology') is satisfied by PR #299 (crates/bbs-mesh/src/transport.rs's no-SelfInfo connect log bumped info->warn with an expanded message). The bd-tracked root cause this issue's own notes already documented (MeshCore's 32-byte advert app_data cap, fixed via PR #229) was resolved long before tonight. Duplicate of supply-drop-bbs-hqm (created fresh this session for the same gh-225 follow-up, already closed). NOTE: GitHub issue #225 itself remains OPEN -- a further/different symptom was found after PR #229 shipped, and the hardware-side root cause of that follow-up symptom is still under investigation by the reporter. Closing this bd issue only because its own specific acceptance criteria are met; not a claim that GH #225 is resolved.

Implemented. Design: reused UserStatus::Banned + a new nullable users.suspended_until TEXT column (migration 0014, plain ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN) instead of a new UserStatus discriminant, avoiding a risky SQLite CHECK-constraint-widening table rebuild. status=Banned+suspended_until=NULL is a permanent ban (unchanged behavior); status=Banned+suspended_until=<ts> is a timeout. Login paths (one-shot and interactive) check suspension only AFTER password verification succeeds, not from a username lookup -- preserves the existing 'don't reveal account status to an unauthenticated caller' anti-enumeration posture while still disclosing days-remaining to someone who has proven they know the password. Auto-reactivates on the next login attempt once expired. UserStore gained suspend()/clear_suspension(); admin_update_user's generic path now clears suspended_until on any explicit status change so a permanent ban or reactivation never carries forward a stale expiry. 3 surfaces: BBS TIMEOUT <user> <days> command (Aide+, matching BAN's level), CLI 'user timeout <user> <days>', web UI (PATCH .../users/:username suspend_days field + Users page timeout button/warning banner). GET /config and GET /users responses surface suspended_until so admin UIs can show it. 8 new bbs-core tests (range validation, session eviction, days-remaining message on both login paths, permanent-ban message unchanged, auto-reactivation, unban clearing a timeout early, BBS command permission/range checks) + 5 tests for the extracted resolve_suspension logic + frontend type-checks clean. Full pre-commit checklist green. PR not yet merged -- held for user review per their own instruction (substantial feature: DB migration + auth-flow changes).
